newsitem.title: USA: ARV Assisted unit tenders for fund units.
newsitem.headline: ARV Assisted unit tenders for fund units.

text.p: ARV Assisted Living Inc said Monday its Lavra Inc unit had started a tender offer for all outstanding units of Senior Income Fund LP at $5.90 net per unit in cash.
The offer deducts the amount of distributions made, announced or paid by the partnership from the date of the offer until the date on which the tendered units are purchased, ARV said.
Beacon Hill Partners Inc is acting as information agent for the offer and IBJ Schroder Bank & Trust Co is the depository, ARV said.
